---
title: "Networks & Connectomes"
description: "Build the network a brain model runs on: connectomes, parcellations, coupling, and heterogeneity."
---

A whole-brain model is dynamics on a **network**. This topic covers getting that
network: where the connectome comes from, how regions are parcellated, how
connections couple, and how to vary behaviour across nodes and edges.

## Learn

- [Surface & PDE simulation](PDESimulation.qmd) — build a surface-based model and
  solve on it with finite elements.

## Do

- [Build a connectome from tractography](BuildConnectomeFromTractography.qmd) —
  tractogram + parcellation atlas → a schema-compliant TVBO network.
- [Hierarchical & surface networks](HierarchicalSurfaceNetworks.qmd) — a fine mesh
  layered onto a coarse parent network.
- [Coupling functions](CouplingFunctions.qmd) — the rule that turns one node's state
  into the signal its neighbours receive.
- [Heterogeneous nodes](HeterogeneousNodes.qmd) /
  [heterogeneous edges](HeterogeneousEdges.qmd) — give regions and connections their
  own behaviour.
